text:
incident-bot: :warning: PROD ALERT: serving-node-12 (us-west1-gpu-a) reporting repeated OOMs and CUDA failures on paged-attention allocator. Affected fleet: hosted-prod-rs-2. Auto-retries 4/5, container restarts observed.

Ava (oncall): I'm on it. seeing pod restart loop on node-12, kube shows OOMKilled on subprocess 'paged-allocator'.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): can you paste the tail of the container logs? specifically allocator tracebacks and any CUBLAS/CUDA errors.

Ava (oncall): pasted logs below:
```
2026-03-15T03:11:08Z runtime: paged_allocator.cpp:327 allocate failed: requested=5242880 available=0
E Cuda: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED: failed to allocate workspace
E Runtime: kv_cache: slab allocator out of contiguous pages, fragmentation=0.78
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
ContainerExitCode=137
```

Maya (eng-sre): node metrics show steady memory creep over 36h on paged-alloc memory pool, ~12%/day. No spike in qps. Looks like slow leak.

Tom (eng-platform): rolling drain of node-12? prefer to move traffic first (disable routing to that AZ) then drain to avoid customer impact. We have spare capacity in us-west1-b.

Ava (oncall): Starting immediate mitigation: 1) mark node unschedulable; 2) migrate active inference traffic off node with routing policy 'avoid-node-12'; 3) spin up 2 extra replicas in us-west1-b; 4) enable canary fallback to smaller quantized model for affected routes. Executing now.

Leila (customer-success): Any customer impact? Are there timeouts or 5xx observed? I have one ticket from Acme.ai reporting failures ~03:06 UTC.

Ava (oncall): Early impact: increased 504s for some interactive sessions routing through node-12 between 03:00-03:12 UTC; automatic retries succeeded for ~70%, others escalated. Will update ACME.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): Quick triage: probable root cause = allocator fragmentation combined with recent allocator change in release v0.12.3 — we added lazy page retirement which may delay compaction. Under certain long-tail sequence workloads KV pages never coalesce, causing fragmentation and eventual allocation failure.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): Immediate runtime mitigation options: a) force compact every 5m (hotfix flag --kv-compact-interval=300), b) enable background defrag thread (feature flag paged_attn.defrag=true), c) rollback allocator lazy retirement to previous behavior. Which do we want first?

Ava (oncall): Maya, can SRE push --kv-compact-interval=300 as a hotpatch to the node daemonset (non-disruptive)? If not, we'll roll a config update and restart the pod after traffic evacuated.

Maya (eng-sre): Pushing hotpatch requires a SIGTERM gracefully; I'll apply config to one node at a time after drainage. Starting on a single replica now.

Tom (eng-platform): also toggling model routing: adding fallback policy to use quantized-3b for routes exceeding 2s queue time. This should lower memory pressure.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): Logged a mitigation PR that adds the hotpatch flag and a small background compaction thread. If compact interval works we can keep while we prepare a rollback of the lazy retirement code path.

Ava (oncall): Hotpatch applied to replica A (hosted-prod-rs-2-a). Observing memory drop ~8% over 10m. No restarts on that replica.

Leila (customer-success): I'll send customer note: impacted customers may have seen transient 5xx between 03:00-03:12 UTC, auto-retries recovered many requests; reaching out to Acme.ai now.

Maya (eng-sre): rolling through remaining replicas. One more node shows same leak pattern; force-compact seems to reduce fragmentation index. Monitoring for 20m before declaring stable.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): Follow-ups: 1) revert lazy retirement in v0.12.4 candidate, 2) add regression test covering long-tail sequence behavior for paged-attn, 3) add eviction/compaction metrics to dashboards (fragmentation ratio, pages-per-slab), 4) add alert for >10% increase in paged-alloc RSS over 24h.

Ava (oncall): Incident todo: oncall->eng-runtime handoff once stable. I'm opening a postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress, traffic rerouted, hotpatch applied to one replica, monitoring. Severity: sev2.

Tom (eng-platform): recording outage window 03:00-03:20 UTC and noting fallback activation. Will coordinate rollback plan with Sanjay.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): ETA for code rollback patch: 6 hours for PR + 2h for canary. If compact flag holds we can do a safer rollback tomorrow.

Ava (oncall): handing off to eng-runtime for root cause/fix tracking. I'll stay on watch for 2 hours in case of flare.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): thanks — I'll take it. Assigning to runtime team, tag: paged-alloc-leak-293847.

Leila (customer-success): Update sent to Acme.ai; they're satisfied with mitigation but want RCA when available.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitoring): node-12 evacuated, hotpatch rolled to remaining replicas, fragmentation decreased, no new OOMs in 45m. Closing thread on stability watch. :white_check_mark:
